SELECT market, count(DISTINCT ticker) tickers, count(*) bars FROM ohlc GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tickers DESC
SELECT market, ticker, D, V, M, composite, label FROM dvm_composite WHERE code='GGG' ORDER BY composite DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT market, ticker, D, V, M, composite, label FROM dvm_composite WHERE code='GGG' AND market='US' ORDER BY composite DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT code, label, count(*) n FROM dvm_composite GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT c.market, c.ticker, c.D, c.V, c.M, c.composite, c.code, c.roe, c.de, c.pe, f.pb, f.roa, f.rev_growth, f.earn_growth, f.op_margin, f.div_yield, f.mktcap FROM dvm_composite c LEFT JOIN (SELECT ticker, pb, roa, rev_growth, earn_growth, op_margin,                   div_yield, mktcap FROM fundamentals) f   ON c.ticker=f.ticker WHERE roe>15 and de<1 ORDER BY c.composite DESC LIMIT 5
